t: Kamma dinim peratiyyim lehilkot yom tob
s: Kamma dinim peratiyyim lehilkot yom tob ubo t"z seipim: shappud shenneeqam venikpap, am yakol litzlot bo kemot shehu beli sheyyapshitennu — asur leposhto beyom tob apillu beyado, mippene shehu toreach beyom tob tircha sheenah tzerika. Veim i epshar litzlot bo belo tiqqun, vegam i epshar limtzo shappud acher apillu etzel adam acher sheepshar lo lishol mimmennu, vegam lo haya epshar lo letaqqeno meereb yom tob, kegon shennikpap beyom tob, o apillu nikpap meereb yom tob velo yada mimmennu ad sheqqiddesh hayyom, o apillu yada mimmennu samuk lachasheka velo haya shahut letaqqeno qodem yom tob — muttar letaqqeno beyom tob. Abal en morin ken leacher, veadam habba lishol halaka zo lemaaseh, dehaynu sheshshoel heak laasot maaseh — en omerim lo hetter zeh, kede shello yitu lehattir ap im haya epshar letaqqeno meereb yom tob veshakach velo tiqqeno, deaz asur min hattora letaqqeno beyom tob, kedin kol makshire "okel nepesh" shehaya epshar laasotan meereb yom tob. Abal kol adam muttar laasot ken meatzmo, ubilbad shello yaaseh ken bipne adam acher sheeno yodea hetter zeh, dekevan sheoseh lepanayv — hare zeh kemoreh lo halaka lemaaseh. Veim nikpap beyom tob rishon — asur letaqqeno beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot im yesh shahut beyom tob rishon kede letaqqeno. Veap al pi shehu yom tob veasur letaqqeno, mikkol maqom, kevan sheanu osin shene yamim mechamat hassapeq shemma harishon hu chol — hare zeh keillu haya epshar laasoto uletaqqeno beyom rishon.

Veken haddin bekol "makshire okel nepesh", sheim haya epshar laasotan beyom tob rishon im haya chol — asur laasotan beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot. Vegam en hetter laasotam ella beno leben atzmo, beinyan shello yilmedu acherim mimmennu, ukemo shennitbaer lemala.

Shappud sherotzeh litzlot bo shehaya arok yoter midday — asur lechatteko o lesorpo kede leqatztzero, mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob. Veim lo haya epshar leqatztzero meereb yom tob, vegam i epshar limtzo shappud acher — muttar leqatztzero, kedin "makshire okel nepesh" shei epshar laasotan meereb yom tob.

Achat sakkin shennipgema veachat sakkin sheomda, apillu eno yakol lachtok bah kelal — en mashchizin otah bemashchezet hammeyuchedet lekak, mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob, vaapillu lo haya epshar lehashchizah meereb yom tob, kegon shennipgema veomda beyom tob. (Veap al pi shekkol makshirim shei epshar laasotam meereb yom tob muttar laasotam beyom tob, mikkol maqom besakkin hechemiru chakamim, lepi shehu dabar hammatzuy etzel rob bene adam, verob happeamim epshar lo lishol sakkin mechabero letzorek yom tob, lepikak apillu im hu beinyan shei epshar lo limtzo sakkin acheret — lo ratzu chakamim lechalleq bekak, veaseru hashchazat hassakkin kedarkah bemashchezet bekol inyan).

Abal hittiru lechaddedah al yede shinnuy, kegon al gabbe sakkin acheret, o al gabbe etz o al gabbe eben o al gabbe cheres, apillu haya epshar lo lechaddedah meereb yom tob, ubilbad shello yaaseh ken bipne adam sheeno yodea hetter zeh, shello yilmad mimmennu lehaqel bedabar zeh, veyattir leatzmo ap bemashchezet, ella im ken en nikkar shehu mitkavven lechaddedah, ella epshar lomar sheeno ella lehaabir shamnunitah shehu muttar. Veen tzarik lomar sheen morin hetter zeh leadam habba lishol halaka lemaaseh, apillu lo haya epshar lechaddedah meereb yom tob, ella kol adam meatzmo muttar laasot ken.

Abal im eno mitkavven lechaddedah ella lehaabir shamnunitah — muttar lehassiah al gabbe chabertah o al gabbe etz vaeben o al gabbe cheres, umorin ken larabbim. Abal lehaabir shamnunitah al gabbe mashchezet — en morin ken, ella kol adam beno leben atzmo muttar laasot ken.

Lo hittiru lechaddedah al yede shinnuy ella kesheadayin yakol lachtok bah al yede haddechaq, dekevan shechiddud al yede shinnuy moil lah, lepikak en chosheshin shemma yechaddedenna bemashchezet. Abal im i epshar lachtok ba kelal — asur lechaddedah apillu al yede shinnuy, dekevan sheen moil lah chiddud al yede shinnuy — yesh lachush im nattir lo lechaddedah al yede shinnuy, shemma yelek vichaddedenna bemashchezet kedarkah.

Opot shemmemalleim otam bebasar ubetzim beyom tob — muttar letopram, shehare tepira zo tzorek "okel nepesh" hi, ubilbad sheyyetaqqen hachut lemiddato (shello yihyeh arok yoter midday) visimennu bemachat meereb yom tob, kede shello yitztarek lachtok et hachut beyom tob kede leqatztzero, veim lo netano bemachat meereb yom tob — asur litteno bemachat beyom tob, shemma yihyeh hachut arok yoter midday velo yukal litpor bo veyachtekennu kede leqatztzero, venimtza metaqqen keli beyom tob. Veap al pi shehittiru lo hattepira — lo hittiru lo meleket tiqqun keli, lepi shehu mi"makshire okel nepesh", vehaya epshar laasotah meereb yom tob. Abal muttar lachtok hachut hannishar taluy baop leachar hattepira, lepi shehi melaka shei epshar laasotah meereb yom tob. Umikkol maqom, nahagu shello lechatteko ella lesorpo, ap al pi shehakkol echad, shekkemo ken hu metaqqen keli (perush gup haop) bisrepat hachut kemo bachatikato.

Muttar lachtok o lisrop beyom tob eged gedayim veopot haqqeshurim beshappud shennitzlu bo, veken muttar lachtok chute tepiratam, veen bezeh mishshum qorea, vaapillu beshabbat muttar lechattekam kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"d, ayyen sham hattaam.

Keli hatztzarik hagala o libbun — asur lehagilo o lelabbeno beyom tob, mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob, vaapillu im rotzeh lehishtammesh bo bayyom letzorek "okel nepesh", mikkol maqom, im haya epshar lehakshiro meereb yom tob ella sheshshakach — asur lehakshiro beyom tob, kedin makshirin sheepshar laasotam meereb yom tob. Veim lo haya epshar lehakshiro meereb yom tob — muttar lehakshiro beyom tob, ella sheen morin ken, kedin makshirim shei epshar laasotam meereb yom tob.

Muttar lelabben beyom tob keli barzel sheapu bo maakal shel gebina kede leepot bo bayyom maakal shel basar ap al pi shehaya epshar lelabbeno meereb yom tob, lepi sheeno nikkar shemmetaqqen keli ella hu mechammemo kede leepot bo. Ubilbad shemmiyyad sheyyaabirennu min haesh yitten bo hammaakal shel basar, abal im yitztannen hakkeli veachar kak yelabbeno shenit kede leepot bo, im ken hare libbun harishon lo haya raq lehakshiro, venimtza asa habara kede letaqqen keli beyom tob.

Vekol zeh keshemmelabben mechalab lebasar o mibbasar lechalab, dekevan sheen tzarik lelabbeno heteb ad sheyyehe nitzotzot nittazim mimmennu ella day lo belibbun qal kemo shennitbaer besimman tn"a ubeyoreh dea besimman qk"a — eno nikkar shemmetaqqen keli, ella hu mechammemo kede leepot bo. Abal asur lelabben beyom tob keli barzel habbalua meissur im haya epshar lelabbeno meereb yom tob, apillu rotzeh leepot maakal shel hetter miyyad sheyyaabirennu min haesh, dekevan shetztzarik lelabbeno ad sheyyihyu nitzotzot nittazim hemennu — hare nikkar shemmitkavven lehakshiro uletaqqen keli beyom tob.

Vekol zeh bikli shemmin haddin tzarik hagala o libbun, abal im eno tzarik ella mechamat chumra bealma, kegon shappud shetztzalu bo basar sheeno maluach verotzeh lachazor velitzlot bo beyom tob — muttar lelabbeno techilla ap al pi shehaya epshar lelabbeno meereb yom tob, dekevan shemmin haddin eno tzarik kelal libbun velo hagala — hare eno metaqqen kelum.

Keshem sheen noqebin neqeb chadash bechabit beshabbat mittaam shennitbaer besimman shy"d — kak en noqebin beyom tob apillu letzorek akila, shehare epshar lenoqbah meereb yom tob. Veim lo haya epshar lenoqbah meereb yom tob — muttar lenoqbah beyom tob, veen morin ken, kedin makshirin shei epshar laasotan meereb yom tob.

Lehadiach kele akila ushetiyya uleshapshepan beyom tob veken lehatbil keli chadash beyom tob — dinan kemo beshabbat, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shk"g. Veim lo haya epshar lehatbilo meereb yom tob — muttar lehatbilo beyom tob ledibre hakkol, abal en morin ken, kedin makshirim shei epshar laasotan meereb yom tob.

Muttar letaltel muqtzeh letzorek akila, kegon abanim hammunnachim al gabbe perot — muttar letaltel haabanim kede leekol happerot beyom tob, lo yehe tiltul hammuqtzeh chamur measiyyat melaka gemura shehuttera letzorek akila. Abal okalin hammuqtzin asur leoklam beyom tob, lepi sheakilat yom tob, ap al pi shehi mitzva, enah docha apillu issur shel dibrehem. Veap al pi shekkol melakot hutteru letzorek akilat yom tob, abal maakalot asurot lo hutteru. Ukeshem sheasur leekol et hammuqtzeh — kak asur lehishtammesh bo apillu letzorek akila, kegon lismok et haqqedera baabanim o baetzim hammuqtzim, shehahanaa shehu neheneh bemah shemmishtammesh bammuqtzeh hi asura kaakila, lepi shettashmishan shel etzim vaabanim zo hi akilatam, velo chillequ chakamim ben etzim vaabanim laokalin umashqin hammuqtzim, veaseru lehishtammesh bekol dabar shehu muqtzeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheoseh maaseh begup hammuqtzeh, kegon shemmetaltel et haeben lismok bah haqqedera, o shemmassiq baetzim hammuqtzim, ap al pi sheeno mezizem mimmeqomam, mikkol maqom, kevan shennoten tachtehem esh umabir otam — hare oseh maaseh begup hammuqtzeh. Abal muttar lehishtammesh bammuqtzeh kesheeno oseh shum maaseh begup hammuqtzeh, kegon lehitchammem keneged hammedura hannaaset meatze muqtzeh o lehishtammesh leoran, veap al pi shehu neheneh mehammuqtzeh, mikkol maqom, kevan shehahanaa ba lo meeleha, sheeno oseh shum maaseh begup hammuqtzeh bahanaato mimmenna — lo gazeru chakamim al kak apillu beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch.
